title: Grade 2 Math — Tue, Jun 17
description: Time — Day 2 of 5: Quarter past and quarter to
subject: mathematics

questions.question: When the minute hand points to 3, we say ___.
questions.explanation: Minute hand at 3 = 15 minutes past the hour = 'quarter past'.

questions.question: When the minute hand points to 9, we say ___.
questions.explanation: Minute hand at 9 = 45 minutes past = 15 minutes BEFORE the next hour = 'quarter to'.

questions.question: Quarter to 6 in numbers is ___.
questions.explanation: Quarter to 6 = 5:45. It is 15 minutes BEFORE 6 o'clock.

questions.question: How many minutes is 'a quarter'?
questions.explanation: A quarter = 15 minutes. Quarter past = 15 min after; quarter to = 15 min before the hour.

questions.question: The hour hand is on 2 and the minute hand is on 3. What time is it?
questions.explanation: Hour hand on 2, minute hand on 3 = 15 minutes past 2 = 2:15 = quarter past 2.

questions.question: The hour hand is near 8 and the minute hand is on 9. What time is it?
questions.explanation: Hour hand near 8 (has almost reached 8), minute hand on 9 = 8:45 = quarter to 9.

questions.question: Aanya's dance class is at quarter past 5. That is ___.
What comes between half past 3 and 4 o'clock?
Arrange in order: (A) 7:00  (B) 7:15  (C) 7:30  (D) 7:45
questions.explanation: 7:00 → 7:15 → 7:30 → 7:45 (o'clock → quarter past → half past → quarter to 8).

questions.question: Rohan finishes homework at quarter to 7. He finishes at ___.
10:45 is the same as ___.
questions.explanation: 10:45 = 45 minutes after 10 = 15 minutes before 11 = quarter to 11.

questions.question: From 3:45 to 4:00 is ___ minutes.
questions.explanation: Quarter to 4 (3:45) to 4 o'clock = 15 minutes. One quarter of an hour.
